name: Cottage cheese (cottage)
note: Ciqual 2025 has no cottage cheese. The nearest plain fresh cheese, 19664 petit-suisse type around 4% fat, is 11% lower on energy and 17% lower on protein. Used: plain cottage at regular fat, including the 7 g fat recipe with identical labels under Madeta and three store brands. Not used: light, half-fat, protein and flavoured products, cod salads, spreads and products sold only in the US.

name: Bread dumpling (houskový knedlík), packaged
note: Ciqual 2025 has no bread dumpling. The closest bread, 7261 French bread home-made, is 10% higher on energy and 25% higher on protein than this median, above every used label. 26265 semolina gnocchi (9% lower on energy, 11% lower on protein) and 7106 whole-grain rye bread (3% and 11% lower) are near in numbers but other foods. Used: plain houskový knedlík with bread rolls. Not used: yeast dumplings without rolls (kynutý, parená knedľa), karlovarský and other types, ready meals, soups and dry mixes. Seven barcodes (Svoboda's own label, store brands and one without a brand) whose labels differ by at most 1 kcal and 0.4 g carbohydrate are taken as one recipe and count once. At the floor of 5 recipes, so a refresh that loses a label loses the row.

name: Quark, fine (jemný tvaroh)
note: Nearest Ciqual: 19664 petit-suisse type, plain, around 4% fat, 13% lower on energy and 42% lower on protein. Used: labels sold as jemný tvaroh. Not used: hrudkovitý (Pilos sells a full-fat product under that word) and jemný polotučný or odtučněný, which are other fat levels.

name: Quark, skimmed (tvaroh odtučněný)
note: Nearest Ciqual: 19663 petit-suisse type, plain, 0% fat, 15% lower on energy and 19% lower on protein. Used: classic skim tvaroh at about 0.5% fat. Not used: high-dry-matter tvaroh sold as odtučněný or měkký (about 87 kcal and 17 g protein), a hrudkovitý and a spreadable tvaroh, one label given per serving and one without values. The energy spread is 9.4% against a bar of 10%, so a refresh may drop this row.
